== Play together ==
* [[Getting started]] — create a room, invite friends or add bots, place your first buildings, and play again.
* [[Accounts and friends]] — usernames, your record, guest expiry, friends online, watching games, and reconnecting.

* [[FAQ]] — quick answers to common surprises.

== About these guides ==
Catanova is an independently developed, open-source game inspired by CATAN. These are original Catanova guides, not an official CATAN publication. Three- and four-player games follow the base-game target; the [[Getting started|two-player option]], [[Getting started|bots]], [[Awards|points target]], [[Map generation|balanced map preset and dice]], and [[Turn timer|timer]] are Catanova choices. Rare development-card cases are marked where their rulings remain provisional. The [[Big Table]] and [[Open Sea]] pages describe planned rules for modes that are not yet playable.

For the complete specification, use the [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/RULEBOOK.md Catanova rulebook] and [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/RULE_SOURCES.md compatibility notes]. See [[Project:Copyrights]] for reuse of this wiki's starter text.
